verdict.rationale: Loops documents an official hosted remote MCP server at https://mcp.loops.so, with a one-line `claude mcp add --transport http` setup. The docs say it works with Claude or any remote MCP client and lets an agent read and write contacts, mailing lists, events, transactional email and content; a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
